Landed on main at d5deb2fc (code tip 8d32a131) (single-developer mode, self-reported gate, LocallyObserved).

Evidence: checkAll on a clean git-archive export of cd4e3165: 5052 tests, 5047 passed, 0 failed or errored, 5 skipped by assume, 51 suite summaries, EXIT 0 The merge with main adds only four .gitignore lines to that tree; no source or resource differs.. media suites 47/47 locally including the caption live court (worker over the verified 4B weights; same text under the same worker). Mutation witnesses for the caption join: 13/13 across two rounds: first cut 6 (shards-verified unchecked; model revision unchecked; applied recipe unchecked; extent ordinals unchecked; worker runtime unchecked; coverage unchecked), hardened court 7 (grid limits unchecked; grid count unchecked; config digest unchecked; verified file set unchecked; offline unchecked; coverage-requested unchecked; extent id unchecked), each killed by its named court with siblings green; the earlier 30 stand. Cold review D found the applied court tautological, the pin incomplete (shards only), and two document splices; all fixed before landing (grid court with binding limits, every model file pinned and the echo compared, ADR and ledger repaired).

Realization: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct @ ebb281ec70b0 (shards 30a01a05…, 046296a2… verified against the repository's LFS digests; config edac7703…), worker media/worker-vlm/caption_worker.py (sha256 22e9d20a…) on mlx-vlm 0.6.17 / mlx 0.32.2 / CPython 3.13.11, offline. F0: three extents over the declared shots -> solid red background / solid green screen / uniform blue colour; declared limits 16384-65536 px gave 6x12-patch grids (the defaults give 12x22), checked by the join; supports [0,16000), [16000,32000), [32000,48000) on 1/24000 from the packet index; two runs byte-identical; outcome sha256 07a91a0d….

Not established: anything about film content (F0's colours are generator ground truth for the plumbing only); no F1 or Sherlock captioning; no §10.4 calibration arm; the 8B arm nominated, not realized (disk); no CaptionProposal -> TimedSegment adapter; the non-grid `applied` fields are the worker's own assignments read back (interpreter and wheel bytes unhashed; offline is a forced switch, not a network assertion); training-data provenance Unknown; weights licence accepted for local research use only, redistribution HoldUnknown.
